name: Agumon (Black) (X-Antibody)
look: a black X-Antibody Agumon scarred with red stripes, with long chrome claws
entry: A black Agumon awakened by the X-Antibody, scarred with red stripes. It breathes a roaring stream of fire and slashes with chrome claws.
how: Wild: common in badlands, volcanic biomes, savannas, spooky biomes and forests.
